headline: QA-focused updates: AI-first bug-harnesses, agent-ready test tooling, runner-deprecation visibility, and test-reporting improvements

top_signal.title: Google releases Mantis — an open-source harness to find, reproduce, and fix bugs at machine speed
top_signal.summary: Google published Mantis, an open-source harness that automates discovery, reproduction, triage, and patch validation for bugs and vulnerabilities — designed to run at scale as part of security and QA workflows.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Mantis directly automates end-to-end bug workflows: reproductions, triage, and patch verification — useful for QA teams scaling automated failure triage and bug-forging pipelines.

items.title: TeamCity 2026.2 makes pipelines GA and adds BYOK for its AI Assistant
items.summary: JetBrains shipped TeamCity 2026.2: YAML pipelines move out of EAP to GA and the AI Assistant gains BYOK (bring-your-own-key) + MCP integrations so teams can run agents against self-hosted or chosen LLMs.
items.why_it_matters: Pipelines GA simplifies replacing legacy build chains with pipeline-as-code; BYOK + MCP lets QA teams run agentic test automation while keeping model data and prompts under enterprise control.

items.title: GitHub Actions adds a runner-deprecation REST API and finer workflow permissions
items.summary: GitHub Actions added GET /actions/runners/deprecations/{version} to show registration/runtime deprecation dates; workflows also get a new vulnerability-alerts GITHUB_TOKEN permission and new job context properties for reusable workflows.
items.why_it_matters: Runner-deprecation visibility helps QA own runner-version compatibility and avoid brownouts; vulnerability-alerts reduces scope creep for security-aware test workflows.

items.title: Playwright 1.62 (1.62.1 patch) folds MCP/agent tooling in and adds 'isolated' retries
items.summary: Playwright's 1.62 line bundles the MCP server/CLI, introduces an 'isolated' retry strategy to isolate flaky tests from concurrency-related failures, and improves diagnostics and reporter hooks.
items.why_it_matters: Bundled MCP lowers friction for running LLM/agent-driven test generation and execution; isolated retries reduce false positives and improve flaky-test triage workflows.

items.title: CLion adds an AI 'hard fault debugging' skill to speed root-cause on embedded failures
items.summary: JetBrains announced a CLion AI skill that aids hard-fault debugging on embedded targets, using MCP-backed tooling to gather register/stack context and propose likely root causes and reproduction steps.
items.why_it_matters: For teams testing on hardware, automated suggestions reduce hands-on debugging time and produce reproducible failure artifacts QA can use in regression tests and flaky-investigation pipelines.

items.title: MPS 2026.2 EAP improves test reporting and flexible result matching for editor tests
items.summary: JetBrains MPS 2026.2 EAP adds flexible result-matching for editor tests and richer failure messages that point to specific nodes and cells — reducing brittle assertions and easing diagnosis.
items.why_it_matters: Better matching and informative failure messages cut fixture maintenance and speed triage for fragile editor/unit tests, reducing test flakiness and developer/QA overhead.

watch.title: Kubernetes v1.37 promotes HPA scale-to-zero to Beta — watch for e2e and infra impacts
watch.summary: Kubernetes v1.37 graduates HorizontalPodAutoscaler scale-to-zero to Beta and enables it by default, adding e2e coverage for scale-down/startup behavior and updating metrics to include CSI driver info.
watch.why_it_matters: Scale-to-zero changes cold-start behavior and test-cluster resource availability; QA teams should monitor flakiness from cold starts and update e2e timing, health probes, and observability checks.

learning.title: Deep-dive: Playwright 1.62 — MCP in the box, isolated retries, and upgrade gotchas
learning.summary: A focused analysis explains how Playwright 1.62 integrates MCP, how 'isolated' retries change flaky-test investigation, and which 1.62.x patches to prefer when upgrading to avoid TypeScript/config regressions.
learning.why_it_matters: Practical upgrade guidance and diagnostic patterns help QA teams adopt MCP-driven agent workflows and use isolated retries to separate flaky tests from concurrency/ordering bugs.
